summary: The StaffMessageService is a web service for retrieving staff messages based on a given StaffMessage ID.
purpose: To provide a method for retrieving the text of a staff message using a staff message ID and session hash.

fields.name: sessionHash
fields.description: The hash representing the session for which the message is being retrieved.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The ID of the staff message to retrieve.

workflows.name: Retrieve Staff Message
steps: Accept sessionHash and id as input parameters.
Convert sessionHash to sessionID using GetSessionIDFromHash.
Search for staff message using StaffMessagesSearchID with sessionID and id.
If found, return the message text; otherwise, return an empty string.

business_rules: The service method gets staff messages only if the session hash and ID are valid.
system_behavior: Uses caching for 60 seconds to optimize performance.
Returns an empty string if the message is not found.
